description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds' implementing 'EffectedSubjectIds', representing sets of subject IDs with granted and revoked permissions. It includes a builder for mutable construction, and methods for creating instances with specific permission sets.

classes.name: ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds
classes.description: An immutable implementation of EffectedSubjectIds, holding sets of granted and revoked subject IDs.

classes.name: ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds.Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds instances with fluent API.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds with specified granted and revoked subject IDs.

methods.name: ofGranted
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds with only granted subject IDs.

methods.name: ofRevoked
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds with only revoked subject IDs.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new Builder instance for constructing ImmutableEffectedSubjectIds.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns the set of granted subject IDs.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns the set of revoked subject IDs.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on granted and revoked subject ID sets.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on granted and revoked subject ID sets.
